Manufactured by Dongguan Shunkai Plastic Co., Ltd., this professional makeup brush handle features a unique patented hexagonal design. The handle is filled with sparkling gold flakes, combining aesthetics with an ergonomic grip.

  • Durable plastic handle with premium decorative elements
Patented product, samples and orders are highly welcomed.

  • 采用进口纳米纤维毛，触感柔软
  • 刷毛紧密、均匀，不吃粉，节省化妆品
  • 高品质塑胶刷柄，搭配精美内部装饰
顺凯专利产品，欢迎拿样与订购。
